summary: The accepted v41 replay leaves the cave-spider hero visible after the hero selects the apples, although the remaining cloak covers the hero. pickup.c:pickup() calls mon.c:hideunder(&youmonst) after processing the floor pile; that source branch sets u.uundetected when a non-trapped M1_CONCEAL hero stands on a coverable floor object. js/pickup.js records this call as unported, and js/mon.js:hideunder() rejects the hero. The missing flag changes the later monster m_move() approach branch and its random calls.

source.branch: After the floor-item loop, pickup.c:pickup() calls hideunder(&youmonst) when the hero is not swallowed and the current form hides under objects. For a cave spider on an untrapped square with a coverable floor object, mon.c:hideunder() sets u.uundetected; it clears the flag when the hero cannot hide. A remaining cloak is a valid cover, so the source redraws the hero square with the cloak glyph. The later monmove.c:m_move() sees u.uundetected and sets appr to 0, which changes its position-selection RNG.
callers: Admitted route: pickup.c:pickup() (672-909) finishes selecting floor objects, then calls hideunder(&gy.youmonst) at 894-896; the v41 recording selects only the apples and leaves the cloak under the cave-spider hero.
Downstream effect: monmove.c:m_move() (1861-1872) forces appr to 0 when u.uundetected is set; the accepted evaluation first differs at step 59 during this monster move.
dependencies: monmove.c:can_hide_under_obj() checks whether the floor pile can cover a hider and rejects non-pit traps.
mondata.c:hides_under() identifies the cave-spider concealment trait.
mondata.c:Resists_Elem() supplies the hero stone-resistance result when the top of the pile is a petrifying corpse.
dbridge.c:is_pool_or_lava() excludes hiding under floor objects in pools or lava.
display.c:newsym() redraws the square when u.uundetected changes.

evidence: Saved queue /home/vtjeng/development/vtjeng/teleport-contest/.cache/latest-saved-combined-queue.json has SHA-256 7505fb24cd01792c8cb781d651dd66ffaa451361e46f7c456fd2705afde0a43a. Its v41 entry reports 1 remaining screen across 60 steps: 59/60 screens, 3101/3108 RNG calls, and 60/60 cursors matched. At segment 0, step 59, key Enter, C displays '[' at row 13, column 38 while JavaScript displays 's'; the same step first diverges at RNG index 3100, C rn2(1)=0 and JavaScript rn2(8)=1, attributed to m_move(monmove.c:1978).

The recorded setup is challenges/cases/v41/v41-hideunder-remaining-cloak-pickup-cfirst.session.json. It polymorphs the hero into a cave spider, wishes and drops two apples on the hero square, opens floor pickup, and selects the apples while leaving the cloak. The recipe comment identifies this as pickup.c:pickup’s post-loop hideunder call.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/pickup.c:894-900 calls hideunder(&gy.youmonst) after the selection loop whenever the hero is not swallowed and hides_under(youmonst.data) is true. Upstream mon.c:4726-4801 contains the complete helper: its hero arm uses u.ux/u.uy and u.utrap, tests the floor pile and terrain, writes u.uundetected at 4775-4780, and redraws at 4799-4800 when the flag changes.

At the examined accepted source commit 6818fe9b759b2ef8ae3d470f38c30808a0734640, js/pickup.js:1686-1695 replaces the source call with note_unported("mon.c hideunder"), and js/mon.js:6540-6544 throws UnsupportedHideError for state.youmonst. This leaves u.uundetected false and renders the hero glyph instead of the cloak glyph. js/monmove.js:3957-3971 then consumes that incorrect flag in m_move’s approach branch, explaining the later RNG divergence.

The same hero-helper gap appears at js/dig.js:2110-2112, js/invent.js:3446-3447, js/polyself.js:1176-1180, js/zap.js:3082-3085 and 6422-6425, and js/mon.js:6677-6680. A complete helper port must wire these supported callers. js/teleport.js:teleds() still refuses the larger hero-as-mimic relocation path before its C hideunder call and remains outside this mismatch’s supported route.
